_comment: One object per photo, rendered on /photos/ grouped by year, newest year first. Within a year, photos keep the order listed here: with three or more, the first spans the full width and the rest share a row below. Fields: year, src (path under /assets/), width and height (the image's pixel size, which sets its shape in the row), caption (blank for none) and alt (describes the photo for screen readers).
